title: Junior Clerk (quota for PACS/OCS of HP)
qualification: (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University (Candidates must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from a School/Institution within Himachal Pradesh - not applicable for Bonafide Himachalis); (ii) Minimum 3 years continuous service as Secretary as defined in Rule 2(vii) of H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules, 1971 of Primary Agriculture Credit Society; (iii) All employees of PACS covered under definition of "Trained Secretaries" are eligible; (iv) Candidate should not be a defaulter of his/her society
salary: Minimum Pay of Rs. 19,900/- (Level-2) + admissible allowances per month (Regular Basis)
age_limit: Candidates must be above 18 years and below 45 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Candidates born between 02-01-1981 and 01-01-2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible. Age relaxation is applicable only to Bonafide Himachali candidates of the respective reserved categories. Selected PwBD candidates will have to submit a Medical Certificate from a competent authority confirming physical fitness to perform duties.

title: Coach (Volley Ball / Foot Ball / Basket Ball / Kabaddi / Badminton / Boxing / Hockey) in Sports Hostels
qualification: Bachelor’s degree from a recognized University + One year diploma in coaching from a National Institute of Sports in the concerned Sports/Game.			OR			Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Coaching awarded by a recognized State Sports University in the concerned Sports/Game.			Must have participated at University/State/National/International level championship in the concerned Sports/Game.			Note: Candidate must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any School/Institution situated within Himachal Pradesh (not applicable to Bonafide Himachalis).
salary: Fixed honorarium on contract basis as per scheme.
application_fee: Examination Fee: ₹100/- || Processing Fee: ₹700/- || Total Fee: ₹800/- (for all categories) || Correction Fee: ₹100/- (during correction window)
selection_process: Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test of 120 marks (1.5 hours duration). || Document Verification. || Final selection on the basis of merit in CBT/Written Test.

title: Teacher (Political Science), Teacher (Sociology), Teacher (Economics), Teacher (Psychology), Teacher (Computer), Teacher (Fine Arts), Teacher (Public Administration), Teacher (Physical Education)
qualification: Master's Degree in concerned subject (min. 50%) + B.Ed. (min. 50%) + TET passed (for most posts)
salary: Fixed Honorarium of ₹30,000/- per month payable for 10 months in an academic year
age_limit: Note : Age is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. Candidates of reserved categories of other States shall be treated as General (UR) category.
application_fee: Fee can be paid through Online Payment Gateway only, using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking. No other mode of payment will be accepted. Examination and processing fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
selection_process: Computer Based Test (CBT): Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit order in the CBT/OMR screening test of 120 marks conducted by the Aayog. No personal interview will be held. || Merit List & Waiting Panel: A category-wise merit list will be prepared based on marks secured in the CBT. In case of a tie, the merit will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in the essential qualification, then by age (senior preferred), and then alphabetically. A waiting panel shall also be prepared: up to 25 advertised posts - 25%; between 25 to 50 posts - 15%; above 50 posts - 10%, subject to minimum numbers. The waiting panel is valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation to the appointing authority. || Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates as per merit will be called for document verification. Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents and self-attested photocopies. The downloaded/printed copy of the online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. No Offline Application Form will be accepted. || Final Recommendation: After document verification, the Aayog will recommend candidates to the appointing authority. Recommendations of the Aayog will be valid till the appointments are offered to the candidates by the Appointing Authority. || Counseling/Allocation: After selection, allocation of schools/posts will be done through merit-based counseling as per Government guidelines.
